Selected projects

I’m Oscar, a second-year Computer Science with AI student at Sheffield Hallam University, looking for a placement year in software development.

Below are the projects I’ve built so far, from a route planner using the A* algorithm to a neural network I trained to recognise squares. Most come with screenshots.

The source code for each project is on GitHub.

Running Route PlannerIn progress

  • C#
  • A* algorithm
  • Vue.js
  • TypeScript
  • Leaflet

A running route application. The C# back end uses the A* algorithm to find routes, and the Vue front end uses TypeScript functions that work with Leaflet to show a map. It’s still being built: phase 1 is the working back end, and phase 2 is the front end as it stands now.

Screenshots

Square Finder

  • Python
  • PyTorch
  • NumPy
  • Pygame

A convolutional neural network (CNN) that looks at a drawing and estimates how much of a square it is, as a percentage. You draw in a Pygame window, and the model trained on a dataset of square and not-square drawings. After 300 epochs it reached 83% accuracy on drawings it hadn’t seen.
